g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_front: Keys: 1000 x 600 x 800 mm envelope - the node size_mm (study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)); the build fills it exactly (hold-down frame + hood vent riser pin the box)
